title: Chapter 432 Bai Xu Shows His Power
content:
Chapter 432 Bai Xu Shows His Power

The Tian Yao Clan was extremely excited, while the other races were very surprised.

They don’t know much about the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon.

But they still have known the young geniuses of the Tiande Clan, but they have never heard of when the Tiande Clan produced a young white tiger.

"This Heavenly Demon Clan is really hidden."

"Yes, some time ago, a terrifying demonic aura suddenly exploded in the Tiande Clan. With such power, there was definitely something big terror hidden in the clan. Now there is a young white tiger suddenly."

"What's even more ridiculous is that some people speculate that the Heavenly Demon Clan is on the decline, which is really a mistake."

Everyone shook their heads slightly, but there was no big negative emotions.

After all, this is a special period, and the Chaos Realm must unite and fight against foreign enemies.

It is a good thing for the Chaos Realm to be able to expose such strength and talent.

At this time, Bai Xu, who was rushing to the list, had already reached the top 30. None of the opponents he encountered was his one-match enemy, let alone let him show his body and explode with all his strength.

Another space trembled, and the opponent in front of him turned into a young girl.

"It's her."

When Bai Xu saw the girl in front of him, he was slightly surprised. This girl was no one else, but the woman who questioned the rules of the Captain of the Huang Guard in full view of the public in the deserted city some time ago.

Bai Xu still remembers that this woman claimed to be the granddaughter of an elder of the Holy Spirit clan.

However, this did not affect Bai Xu's move.

Facing Bai Xu, the girl's eyes were slightly sunken and she did not choose to surrender.

At the beginning of the battle, Bai Xu did not say a word and swooped towards the girl directly, with a majestic momentum.

Bai Xu has always used his physical body to fight against the enemy. The Heavenly Demon Clan is all strong in body and has deep qi and blood. As one of the four symbols of Heavenly Demon, the White Tiger, known for killing, is naturally even more powerful.

Seeing Bai Xu rushing towards him directly, the girl hurriedly retreated, waved her hand, and several holy lights emerged out of thin air, shooting towards Bai Xu.

Boom boom boom boom!

The roar sounded, the holy light was powerful, the power of breaking the ring was very strong, and the waves of air spread out like tides.

At this moment, the girl's aura was also revealed.

The peak of Taixu Realm!

"Have you won?"

Looking at the harm she caused in the distance, the girl was delighted, but she didn't expect that Bai Xu actually looked like a good person.

But not long after she was happy, a afterimage suddenly appeared behind the girl like a flash.

Feeling the chill coming from behind, the girl was shocked.

laugh!

Blood spurts.

Blood surged in the girl's mouth, her face turned pale, she looked down with difficulty, and a bloody hand suddenly penetrated her heart from behind and then extended to her body.

She was dead, she was going to die.

Why is this happening? I am just keeping the list, why do I have to be so cruel?

The girl's eyes were filled with tears, and with a thump, she fell into a pool of blood unwillingly.

The girl is obviously still a little ignorant about the rules of the list.

Seeing the girl falling to the ground, Bai Xu's face was calm and he wiped the blood on his hands calmly.

He was a little reluctant when he first killed someone, but now he is used to it. Anyway, he is not really dead. He likes such a battle very much.

In this way, both sides can truly leave no room for anything.

The scene switched, and the girl's body slowly dissipated.

Bai Xu adjusted his emotions and prepared to welcome the next opponent.

The girl reappeared in front of the genius list after a short period of time.

"ah!!"

Opening her bright eyes, the girl made a frightened sound, and then squatted and gasped.

Everyone around him had no reaction to the girl's scream. They just glanced at her and then looked at herself, either closing their eyes to rest or watching the changes in the list.

Obviously, everyone is used to it.

At this time, the girl finally understood that fighting in the list is not real death.

I looked up at my ranking and it had dropped by one.

"Bai Xu, Tian Yao, White Tiger?"

The girl stared at Bai Xu who was changing on the genius list, with a hint of resentment in her eyes.

He really doesn't show any mercy and cares about his beauty.

But then, she became very worried again, because she happened to catch the opening of the Tianjiao List when she came here, so she had a little idea and got a very good ranking in vain.

At this time, she had already reacted. If a powerful genius came here to compete for the list next time, she would not have died dozens of times.

Thinking of the feeling of dying just now, the girl felt a chill.

She really doesn't want to experience such despair anymore.

Surrender was the only way out she thought of. Although it was a bit embarrassing, there was nothing she could do about it.

So she made up her mind and surrendered directly when she met someone who seemed very strong.

At the same time, within the Heavenly Demon Clan.

"Hahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!"

The leader of the Tiande Clan laughed loudly and was in a very happy mood. Unexpectedly, the four-size white tiger in the Heavenly Demon that he could not find would appear on the battle power list of Huangcheng.

It’s really a place to search for something without any effort!

At this time, the subordinates came down to report, "Class leader, Lord Ao Qing is back with Miss Bai Ling!"

"Damn it? Hahaha, it's such a happy couple!"

"Hurry, come and greet me!"

At this time, the patriarch of the Tian Yao tribe smiled happily, his eyes narrowed to a madman, and he was so happy that he took his troops outside with his troops.

I saw Ao Qing, who looked dispersed and looked indifferent, lay on the back of Zhuque Bailing, and was swaying towards him.

No wonder Ao Qing and Bai Ling arrived at the Heavenly Demon Clan today.

Ao Qing actually rode Bai Ling over.

Even the leader of the Tian Yao Clan was slightly stunned when he saw this scene, but he quickly reacted and hurried forward and said respectfully, "I'll pay homage to Lord Ao Qing!"

"Um."

Ao Qing nodded slightly and slowly lowered from Bai Ling's back.

Bai Ling returned to his human form and followed Ao Qing obediently, like a maid.

"I came back this time by following the orders of my master to integrate the power of the Heavenly Demon Clan and fight against the land of the gods."

As he said that, Ao Qing's sharp dragon pupil looked at the leader of the Tiande Clan, "The war is coming, the Tiande Clan will not still plan to hold back, just wait and see, right?"

Feeling Ao Qing's invading gaze, the patriarch of the Tian Yao clan's heart beat wildly and quickly denied: "My Lord Ao Qing, this is naturally impossible."

"Now that the land of gods is coming, it is an enemy of the entire Chaos Realm. As a member of the Chaos Realm, our Tiande Clan naturally has to do its best to resist to the end."

The patriarch of the Tian Yao clan's tone was heavy and powerful, and he vowed to fight to the death with the land of the gods.

At least, his words are beautiful.

Ao Qing also enjoys this trick very much.

In response to this, Ao Qing nodded with satisfaction. The task he came here this time was also completed.

Anyway, he felt that.
